card.name: Poison Help line number digit
card.fires_on: Mainly the digit 8 starting 800 in the Poison Help line phone number (1-800-222-1222) in overdosage sections. Weaker hits on 'provider' or 'dis' in 'discontinue' in warning text.

modes.label: Poison Help phone number
modes.description: The 8 of 1-800 in the Poison Help line number after an overdose sentence.
modes.example: In the event of an overdose with STEGLATRO, contact the Poison Help line (1-<<8>>00-222-1

modes.label: Instructions to tell or stop
modes.description: A word in a warning instruction such as 'provider' after 'Tell your healthcare' or 'dis' in 'discontinue'.
modes.example: Tell your healthcare<< provider>> if you think your condition has gotten worse
